How to rotate and organise PDF pages

  1. Add your PDF — drag it into the box above, or click to browse. A preview of every page appears below.
  2. Rotate — use the curved arrows under a page to turn it left or right in 90° steps.
  3. Reorder or delete — use the side arrows to move a page, or the × button to remove it (click again to bring it back).
  4. Click "Download PDF" — the organised document downloads straight to your device.

Frequently asked questions

Can I rotate only one page?

Yes. Every page has its own rotate buttons, so you can turn a single sideways page and leave the rest untouched.

If I delete a page by mistake, can I get it back?

Yes. Click the restore button on the removed page (it appears greyed out) and it comes back. Nothing is final until you download.

Does rotating change the quality?

No. Rotation only changes the page's orientation setting — the content itself is not re-drawn, so quality stays exactly the same.

Are my files uploaded to a server?

No. Everything happens entirely in your browser, on your device. Your files are never sent anywhere.
